{{Quote|Fetch me some mealbread when you come back, please.|Altis|<ref name="NP">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref>}}
'''Mealbread''' was a type of processed bread product developed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the beginning years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The bread could be baked into chips, sticks, or a variety of other shapes. It had enough nutrients to make it the equal of a small meal.<ref name="cuswe">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

They were sold in sticks by vendors in front of the Treasury building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="tz">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref>
